parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the query results. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query.

parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description:
The service code. Valid values:
- **cloudauthst**: Enhanced Finance Edition.
- **antcloudauth**: Finance Edition.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The whitelist status. Valid values:
- **VALID**: Valid.
- **INVALID**: Invalid.
- **DELETED**: Deleted.

parameters.name: ValidEndDate
parameters.description: The end time of the validity period.

parameters.name: ValidStartDate
parameters.description: The start time of the validity period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
